<template>
    <v-dialog v-model="dialog" max-width="500px">
      <v-card>
        <v-card-title class="text-h5">Import Transactions</v-card-title>
        <v-card-text>
          <v-file-input
            v-model="file"
            label="Select Excel or CSV file to import"
            accept=".csv, .xlsx, .xls"
            :rules="[v => !!v || 'File is required']"
            @change="handleFileChange"
            :disabled="isAnalyzed"
          ></v-file-input>
          <v-alert
            v-if="isAnalyzed"
            type="info"
            class="mt-4"
          >
            Broker could not be automatically identified. Please select a broker for import.
          </v-alert>
          <v-select
            v-if="isAnalyzed"
            v-model="selectedBroker"
            :items="brokers"
            item-title="name"
            item-value="id"
            label="Select Broker"
            class="mt-4"
          ></v-select>
        </v-card-text>
        <v-card-actions>
          <v-spacer></v-spacer>
          <v-btn color="blue darken-1" text @click="closeDialog">Cancel</v-btn>
          <v-btn 
            v-if="!isAnalyzed" 
            color="blue darken-1" 
            text 
            @click="analyzeFile" 
            :disabled="!file"
          >
            Analyze File
          </v-btn>
          <v-btn
            v-if="isAnalyzed"
            color="blue darken-1"
            text
            @click="importTransactions"
            :disabled="!selectedBroker"
          >
            Import Transactions
          </v-btn>
        </v-card-actions>
      </v-card>
    </v-dialog>
  </template>
  
  <script>
  import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
  import { getBrokers, importTransactions } from '@/services/api'
  import { useErrorHandler } from '@/composables/useErrorHandler'

  export default {
    name: 'TransactionImportDialog',
    props: {
      modelValue: Boolean,
    },
    emits: ['update:modelValue', 'import-completed'],
    setup(props, { emit }) {
      const dialog = computed({
        get: () => props.modelValue,
        set: (value) => emit('update:modelValue', value)
      })

      const file = ref(null)
      const isLoading = ref(false)
      const isAnalyzed = ref(false)
      const selectedBroker = ref(null)
      const brokers = ref([])

      const { handleApiError } = useErrorHandler()

      const handleFileChange = (event) => {
        console.log('File selected:', event)
        isAnalyzed.value = false
        selectedBroker.value = null
      }

      const closeDialog = () => {
        dialog.value = false
        file.value = null
        isAnalyzed.value = false
        selectedBroker.value = null
      }

      const analyzeFile = async () => {
        if (file.value) {
          isLoading.value = true
          try {
            // Instead of sending the file for analysis, we just set isAnalyzed to true
            isAnalyzed.value = true
          } catch (error) {
            handleApiError(error)
          } finally {
            isLoading.value = false
          }
        }
      }

      const importTransactions = async () => {
        if (file.value && selectedBroker.value) {
          isLoading.value = true
          try {
            const result = await importTransactions(file.value, selectedBroker.value)
            emit('import-completed', result)
            closeDialog()
          } catch (error) {
            handleApiError(error)
          } finally {
            isLoading.value = false
          }
        }
      }

      const fetchBrokers = async () => {
        try {
          brokers.value = await getBrokers()
        } catch (error) {
          handleApiError(error)
        }
      }

      onMounted(fetchBrokers)

      return {
        dialog,
        file,
        isLoading,
        isAnalyzed,
        selectedBroker,
        brokers,
        handleFileChange,
        closeDialog,
        analyzeFile,
        importTransactions
      }
    }
  }
  </script>
